mapper.insert: insert into reference_pairs(tag, notes, region_adcode, from_poi_id, from_poi_name, to_poi_id, to_poi_name, created_at) values (#{tag}, #{notes}, #{regionAdcode}, #{fromPoiId}, #{fromPoiName}, #{toPoiId}, #{toPoiName}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, tag, notes, region_adcode, from_poi_id, from_poi_name, to_poi_id, to_poi_name, created_at from reference_pairs order by created_at desc
